title: Harness of Minervini v2 watchlist.history response

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol whose recorded history should be read.

limitations: History is keyed by recorded ticker events; stable instrument identity remains in each record.
--as-of stamps this read and does not time-filter events.
x-capability-contract.output: Recorded events in ledger order; an absent ledger or symbol returns an empty list without creating state.

status_meanings.ok: Events or a legitimate empty list were returned.

x-capability-contract.summary: Read the explicit research-event history for one ticker symbol.
